deduplication: exact directed rule_id; A->B and B->A remain separate; no refill after deduplication
hybrid: union of C frozen G budget50 and all three L groups' system-budget50 slots; all rules shared globally
matched_baseline: G first K directed rules from frozen budget100 ranking, K=hybrid unique rule count
secondary_baseline: G budget50, showing marginal gain from adding L rules
population: same 4862 eligible Validation orders / 1458 active customers; empty and single-category baskets retained
quality: same primary point/count/customer gates as validation_quality_v1; all unioned/shared rules evaluated globally; one common BY family of unique GLOBAL rule_ids across all five hybrid and matched baseline lists; no refilling

bootstrap.interval: percentile95 for fixed-list raw coverage differences only

limits: Intervals are exploratory and pointwise; five configs not multiplicity-corrected
Quality-filtered coverage is retrospective within Validation; no predictive claim
Different configs can have different K; compare each hybrid only with its own matched G_K
No random-hybrid control in this batch; improvement would not by itself establish RFM-specific advantage
